title: Primary Outcomes of Accelerated Epithelium-Off Corneal Cross-Linking in Progressive Keratoconus in Children: A 1-Year Prospective Study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license xlink:href=http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>: Creative Commons Attribution License; ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

groups.description: 47 eyes of 25 children aged 9-14 years with progressive keratoconus (thinnest pachymetry at least 400 um, Kmax not above 53 D); epithelium-off accelerated CXL under general anaesthesia, riboflavin 0.1% with HPMC (VibeX Rapid) for 15 minutes, UVA 18 mW/cm2 for 5 minutes (5.4 J/cm2, KXL); prospective interventional case series

exclusions.what: visits at 1 week and 1, 3 and 8 months
exclusions.reason: Kmax not tabulated at these visits (only preoperative and 1 year)

exclusions.what: correlation of densitometry with K max after 1 year (Results text)
exclusions.reason: correlation coefficients are not admissible values

notes: Kmax identity: the Table 3 row is labelled 'K max (diopters)' and the Methods define the measure as 'the steepest keratometry (K max)' on Pentacam; the Results text calls the same values 'steepest K'. Admitted as Kmax under the table label and the Methods definition.
Single-arm study of a standard accelerated protocol without a declared experimental arm: role control.

Table 3 also gives CDVA, UCVA and thinnest pachymetry; Tables 1-2 give Scheimpflug densitometry and its correlation with CDVA; haze, HOAs and endothelial cell count are reported in the text (not extracted).
Licence CC BY 4.0: the record and the source XML are public.

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical Analysis: normally distributed continuous data as means and standard deviations); unit dioptres in the row label; Pentacam per Methods; column '1 year postoperative' = 12 months; all 47 eyes attended every scheduled visit up to 1 year
